name: Knight's Adventure - an inverse Tower Defense game
author: felagund1789
description:
A lot of LEGO fans have grown up with classic Castle and have spent hundreds of hours playing with knights and soldiers, pitting every faction against each other in glorious battles.

I certainly was one of them!

In this game you can select a character between 5 choices (Forestmen, Black Knights, Crusaders, Black Falcons and a generic soldier) and play your way through a maze of towers, in order to collect all the shields and win the game.

I hope you enjoy playing this game as much as I did creating it!

Notes:
- Press the TAB key to pause the game, access the controls, or take a screenshot.
- All models were created with Bricklink Studio 2.0.
- There is only one level, currently, but I will gradually add more levels.
